comment: Palutena's authored data over Peach's export (docs/P6/characters/palutena.md). Her look (main 0x1B00, model 0x1B03) is written by scripts/p6/model_writer.py from the owner's Blender model (scripts/p6/look_blend.py); the files are kit-derived build outputs under builds/p6-art/palutena/look (D10). Clips are built from art/p6/palutena/anims (anim.py --build) into builds/p6-art/palutena/anims; her specials' routines are in src/port/nds_p4_palutena.c. CPU rows (cpu): Peach's rows measured on her own moves by scripts/p6/coverage.py; Warp makes no hitbox and drops out.

skirt.comment: Owner playtest 2026-10-14: in every animation the dress surrounds her legs, except at the slit. Her skirt hangs from Peach's dress rows (scripts/p6/look_skirt.py); every clip she plays gets rows 25 and 26 keyed from her legs (scripts/p6/skirt_keys.py).

pose.comment: Walks (WalkSlow, WalkMiddle, WalkFast, WalkEnd): Peach's with a smaller stride under the dress and the staff held up as in her wait (owner's 3DS walking reference, 2026-10-14).
Dash, Run, RunBrake, TurnRun: Peach's with a smaller stride and the body leaning into the run (the 3DS running reference).
Turn, KneeBend, jumps, falls and landings: Peach's with the legs closer together under the dress (the 3DS jumps reference).
Squat, SquatWait, SquatRv: Peach's crouch with the knees together under the dress.
Dash, Run, RunBrake (owner p6i: her floating run): their own clips; the dress trailed behind her (skirt_keys.py trail).
